description:
A librarian at the Ark's library who works alongside Phantom.
She keeps her distance from others due to her chronic delusions and gloomy personality, but deep down she craves friendship and love, and dreams of the day she'll finally find them.

levels.name: Meeting and Parting (Imagined)
levels.description:
■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Delusion: Creates a <word_group=10023>shield</word_group> with HP equal to 17.82% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP. This effect is continuous.</color>
■ Activates when Delusion ends. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Delusion Shattered: Activates up to 2 time(s). This effect is continuous.
Effect 1: Imagined Heartbreak: <word_group=10004>Prevents being targeted by single-target attacks</word_group> for 1 sec x Delusion Shattered count. This effect is removed upon taking a direct hit.
Effect 2: Stuns for 1 sec per Delusion Shattered stack.</color>
■ Activates when performing a normal attack while not in the Delusion state. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Delusion: Creates a <word_group=10023>shield</word_group> with HP equal to 17.82% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP. This effect is continuous.</color>
■ Activates when using Burst Skill while not in the Delusion state. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Delusion: Creates a <word_group=10023>shield</word_group> with HP equal to 17.82% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP. This effect is continuous.</color>

Label costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text: A-am I even worthy... of being in your presence?

Y-you... don't really want me here, do you?
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry for overstepping...
I-if that's what you want, I'll go sit in the trash can over there...
Just trust me from now on... I'll be watching your every move... Every morning, noon, evening, even in the dead of night... Hehehe...
Ahh... I knew it. Fate must have led me here...

Hehehe... If a man and a woman find themselves alone in a place like this...
There's really only one thing they should do. Don't you think?

H-huh...? Where did you go...?
Y-you're not... meeting another woman, are you...?

Hehehe... N-not here... I-I'm not ready yet...
Ah...! H-hey... wh-when did you come back...?
I-I... just want to hurry back to my room...
Th-there are too many people here...
Eek...! Y-you scared me...

Oh! You finally came for me...!
I knew we were destined to meet... Hehehe.
Hehe, good... Now we can stay together a little longer...
Hehehe... Does this mean I don't have to worry about being abandoned anymore?

You're treating me so well...
Does that mean you want to be with me forever...? Hehehe...
I-if you keep this up... I might start getting the wrong idea...
Hehehe... I'll cherish the gift you gave me... Forever...

*Sniff sniff* Ohh, this smells just like you...
If I sleep with it by my side... it'll feel like I'm sleeping next to you! Hehe...
Ahh... I could die happy today...
I'll say it as many times as you want. I like you. I like you, I like you, I like you, I like you, I like you...
For you, I'd give everything... My time, my money, even my entire life...

H-have you guys ever kissed? Well, I have...
I-in my imagination, of course... Hehehe...
Wh-what's the matter...? Did I do something wrong...?
I-I don't want to... But if that's what you want...
Can someone like me really be of help...?
I have to show my best side...
If I win this battle... then I'm yours... Hehehe...
Hehehe... Keep your eyes on me, all right?
Reload, reload, reload...
C-come on, reload...
I-I'll be quick. Just don't call me useless...
I'll do anything you command...!
Ahh, yes... We were meant to be together...!
I'll handle everything that bothers you...!
... Die.
Hehehe... G-gotcha.
Get out of my way...
This is the worst...
I don't like this...
Why...?
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry for being useless...
Now that every enemy standing between us is gone... does this mean we can finally hold our wedding...? Hehehe.
D-does this costume look weird...? I should've just stuck to what I usually wear...
